title: Hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval for repository-aware code assistance
abstract: Hybrid retrieval can recover exact symbols with lexical matching while using semantic search for conceptually related examples, improving context relevance under a fixed budget.

fixture_excerpts: Hybrid retrieval combines exact symbol matching with semantic search, which can improve context relevance when the retrieved context budget is fixed.

title: Reranking and deduplication for compact code-generation context
abstract: Reranking retrieved snippets by task relevance and removing near-duplicates can reduce noisy context, but may discard rare examples if the scorer is poorly calibrated.

fixture_excerpts: Reranking and near-duplicate removal can reduce noisy context, although a miscalibrated scorer may suppress rare but useful examples.

title: Latency and context-budget tradeoffs in interactive code assistants
abstract: Interactive assistants face latency limits. Retrieval depth, reranking cost, and prompt length must be balanced against suggestion quality and developer interruption.

fixture_excerpts: Retrieval depth, reranking cost, and prompt length create latency tradeoffs for interactive code assistants.
